날씨 앱 읽기: 우산이 필요해요? 마스크가 필요해요?

Learners can find the temperature, chance of rain, and dust levels on a Korean weather app. They can answer '우산이 필요해요?' or '마스크를 써야 해요?' with yes or no and a one-sentence reason.

THE APP SCREEN

Read this weather app screen. All the questions use it.

오늘 맑음 · 최저 12° · 최고 23° · 강수확률 10% · 미세먼지 나쁨 · 초미세먼지 보통

내일 비 · 최저 14° · 최고 19° · 강수확률 80% · 미세먼지 좋음 · 초미세먼지 좋음

WORDS ON THE SCREEN

Learn the words that appear on the weather app screen.

최저
the lowest, i.e. the low temperature for the day.아침에는 최저 12도예요.
In the morning it's 12 degrees, the low for the day.
최고
the highest, i.e. the high temperature for the day.오후에는 최고 23도예요.
In the afternoon it reaches 23 degrees.
강수확률
the chance of rain or snow. It is pronounced [강수황뉼].강수확률이 10%예요.
The chance of rain is 10%.
미세먼지
fine dust in the air (PM10).오늘은 미세먼지가 많아요.
There's a lot of fine dust today.
